description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
